# [TASK] Upgrade RTK 1 → 2 and MUI 5 → 6

## Task
Install @reduxjs/toolkit@2 + react-redux@9, and @mui/material@6 + @mui/icons-material@6 + @emotion/react@11 + @emotion/styled@11. Run `npm run codemod:mui`. Fix any breaking-change usages surfaced by the codemod or TypeScript/ESLint errors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `npm ls @reduxjs/toolkit` shows 2.x; no RTK deprecation warnings in console. — `2.12.0`, verified via `npm ls` and a clean `npm test` run (no console warnings).
- [x] `npm ls @mui/material` shows 6.x; no MUI deprecation warnings in console. — `6.5.0`, same verification.
- [x] `npm run build` exits 0 with no errors. — builds clean (752KB bundle, pre-existing chunk-size notice only).

## Notes
`@mui/styles` (JSS-based `makeStyles`) has no React 19-compatible release and was blocking `npm ci` outright. Replacing it was necessary to make this Task's criteria reachable, not scope creep. All 12 `styles.js` modules and their consumers moved to `tss-react/mui`'s `makeStyles` — the same `theme => ({...})` hook shape, and MUI's own recommended replacement.

`codemod:mui` pointed at a nonexistent `v6.0.0/preset-safe` transform (that naming is v4-to-v5 era); fixed to `deprecations/all`, the real v6 deprecation fixer. It auto-fixed `Typography paragraph` and `TextField InputProps` to `slotProps`. Two `<ListItem button>` uses in `Sidebar.jsx` were hand-fixed to `<ListItemButton>`.

The 2 hanging `uploadMedia` tests are unrelated and pre-existing — tracked as #132.
